description: This file defines the PageSetup class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, responsible for managing page layout configurations such as size, orientation, margins, and format for sections in documents.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Represents the page layout settings for a section, including size, margins, orientation, and other formatting options.

classes.name: PageSetup.PageSetupValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable properties for PageSetup parameters.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PageSetup object.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Freezes the PageSetup instance to prevent further modification.

methods.name: GetPageSize
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the page width and height based on the specified PageFormat.

methods.name: ResetPageSize
methods.description: Resets page size properties, allowing new values to be set.

methods.name: PreviousPageSetup
methods.description: Returns the PageSetup of the previous section if available.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PageSetup object into a format suitable for saving or transmission.
